goal: Establish Qatari Kitchen with 200 new authentic dishes (Supabase)
notes: Dry-run proposal. All dishes grounded in Qatari culinary tradition (national machboos, thareed, harees, madrouba, margooga, street foods of Souq Waqif; regional Gulf shared dishes tagged gulf_shared). Per golden rule, pan_qatari is the default region. cal_100 are kitchen-standard estimates within [20,900].
